opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March for a decision in May
15 September for a decision in November
15 December for a decision in March

next_open_date.raw: 31 March for a decision in May

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Our small grants are awarded as ‘seed funding’ with the aim of enabling projects that might otherwise not be possible without our support. Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health
opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health

deadlines.raw: 1 December, for a decision in March of the following year

next_open_date.raw: 1 December, for a decision in March of the following year

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 for one-year projects, up to £30,000 for multi-year projects.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study.
opportunities.summary: Butterfield Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK.
